name: DiffGrowthBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a differential growth coral. The object displays a complex, low-spreading form of ruffled and folded lobes generated by a differential growth algorithm — smooth thin sheets curl and overlap organically, creating a lettuce-like or ruffled ribbon structure. Without any texture or material color, the pure white geometry clearly exposes the intricate folded topology, with dramatic shadows cast between the overlapping layers.
